messages:
Alisa L.: Quick sync: we're prepping a marketplace private offer that bundles HW credits from Nimbus Inc. Goal: 12-month committed spend with a staggered discount curve. Need input on SKU anchoring and announcement cadence.
Mike T.: rough numbers? target ARR or usage floor?
Alisa L.: Target ARR = $1.2M over 12mo. Prefer a 2-tranche commit: 70% reserved + 30% flex usage. HW credits to be frontloaded 40% first 3 months as adoption kicker.
Jamal (PM): sounds good. For SKU anchoring, can we tie the frontloaded credits to a 'starter' SKU so usage maps cleanly? avoids accounting headaches.
Sophia - Partnerships: @Jamal yes. Also need to align co-sell announcement timing with Nimbus marketing — they want a joint press release in Q3. Does legal need 6 weeks?
Dana Legal: Confirming: we'll need final T&Cs 5w before announce. Also require export control checklist if hardware ships to EMEA.
Mike T.: One more ask: can we set renewal opt-in trigger at 9 months with an automated uplift discount if usage > 80%?
Alisa L.: Agree. Ops: can we implement a renewal uplift hook that checks usage and applies a 5% bonus credit on renewal?
deploy-bot: Checklist created: <https://internal.docs/runs/2317/scheduler|marketplace-offer-checklist>
Jamal (PM): Config snippet for billing mapping: ```json
{"sku_map": {"starter": "hw-kicker-40pct", "reserved": "redwood-dedicated"}, "renewal_trigger_month": 9}
```
Sophia - Partnerships: :thumbsup: I'll sync with Nimbus on PR windows. If legal needs 5w, we should lock wording by June 10.
Dana Legal: Noted. Also flag: we need proof of HW supply chain commitments from Nimbus if they promise physical appliances.
Mike T.: Operational note: how do we handle partial consumption? Suggest prorated conversion to credits at month boundary.
Alisa L.: Good point. Ops, can you draft consumption->credit conversion table?
Jamal (PM): I'll draft and share by EOD tomorrow.
Sophia - Partnerships: I'll loop in Nimbus PM on that thread once Jamal posts.
deploy-bot: Reminder set: #marketplace-launch-sync on 2317655000
